tasks.label: wait-mysql
tasks.command: for i in {1..30}; do echo "Attempt $i: Waiting for MySQL to be ready..."; if docker exec bajkpaker-mysql sh -c "mysql -u root -pBajkPaker93.83 -e 'SELECT 1'" > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "MySQL is ready!"; exit 0; fi; sleep 2; done; echo "Timed out waiting for MySQL"; exit 1
